items.title: DexCom (DXCM) Could Be 32% Undervalued Following Health Canada G7 Pregnancy Clearance

items.title: How Pregnancy Device Approval At DexCom (DXCM) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Health Canada has approved use of the Dexcom G7 continuous glucose monitoring system within the myLoop automated insulin delivery setup for pregnancy, supported by AiDAPT trial data showing improved time in pregnancy specific glucose targets without added hypoglycemia risk.
